slides.label: Cloud route worksheet
slides.source_text: Optional reference · Back to the talk In practice Verify the configured boundary Identify the provider, region and any cross-region inference routing. Confirm the relevant retention, logging and identity settings. Check model availability, quotas, pricing and your organization’s agreement. A cloud brand alone does not establish residency or prevent data from leaving a region.

slides.label: Compare instruction variants
slides.source_text: Optional reference · Back to the talk In practice Exercise · compare two versions fairly 10 minutes A: the long instruction file. B: the shorter version. Use identical task inputs, repo state, model and tools. Record: acceptance results, all usage, time and retries. Repeat runs if available; inspect failures before choosing. Output: a comparison worksheet and one justified decision. A smaller prompt that drops the VAT rule loses.
